title: Troubleshooting No. 3: No anti-roll function
ocr_text:
FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — TOYOTA Electronic Modulated Suspension     FA-33

Troubleshooting No. 3: No anti-roll function

Initial check
(See page FA-30)

Do TEMS indicator lights indicate as shown below when the steering wheel is turned sharply while driving at 40 km/h (25 mph)?

Vehicle speed above 40 km/h (25 mph) | Sharp turn
Lights Position | S M F | S M F
Normal | ON OFF OFF | ON ON ON
Sport | ON ON OFF | ON ON ON

Yes → Road test again.

No ↓

Check steering sensor and circuit.

Bad → Repair or replace.

OK ↓

Check speed sensor and circuit.

Bad → [connects to Repair or replace]

OK ↓

Try another TEMS computer.
